title: KIWI PINEAPPLE  – VAPEHUB ULTRA 20000
description: KIWI PINEAPPLE is a tantalising tropical escape that dances on your palate. The luscious sweetness of ripe kiwis, their vibrant green flesh bursts with juicy flavour, perfectly harmonising with the sun-kissed tang of fresh pineapple. Each inhale is like a refreshing island breeze, transporting you to a paradise where fruity bliss reigns. This flavour delivers a delightful balance of tart and sweet, evoking sun-soaked days and carefree adventures.
